A_general.open_code_note: No public repository for the customer-created server was found in the prepared repository bundle or linked official sources. The available documentation describes Zoho's hosted, configurable MCP product.
other_official_servers: Zoho publishes regional service origins including https://mcp.zoho.com, https://mcp.zoho.eu, https://mcp.zoho.in, https://mcp.zoho.com.au, https://mcp.zoho.jp, https://mcp.zoho.ae, https://mcp.zoho.sa, https://mcp.zohocloud.ca, and https://mcp.zoho.sg. These are regional origins; the customer's configured endpoint is unique and not supplied.

Zoho CRM also documents four pre-built MCP server variants: Data Insights, Data Operations, Module Customization, and Workflow & Process Automation. Their tools are distinct from the unspecified customer endpoint.

B_access_pricing.mcp_access_cost_details: Zoho states that MCP has no separate subscription or activation charge and is included for Zoho users. Use consumes the API quota of the connected Zoho services; third-party integrations consume their own service quotas.
B_access_pricing.linked_software_cost: Varies by connected Zoho or third-party service and plan; no single software price is stated on the MCP pricing page.
B_access_pricing.pricing_model_details: MCP license: $0. Calls use existing Zoho API limits and the connected third-party service's API policies. The linked product's plan, limits, and task quotas continue to apply.
B_access_pricing.other_access_restrictions: A user needs authenticated credentials for configured services. Some Zoho Mail tools require organization administrator privileges. Zoho Mail docs describe OAuth 2.1 authorization on demand or via an organization-level connection. An AI client's own plan may be required for its MCP integration features.
B_access_pricing.restrictions_controlled_by: Zoho, the connected service's administrator, and the user who selects tools and configures authorization; the MCP client's feature access is controlled by its provider.

D_server_side_logic.additional_logic: 1. Official Zoho Mail reference names read and write tools, including destructive operations such as deleting mail, folders, users, domains, and IP allow-list entries. No tool annotations are shown in that reference; endpoint annotations are Unknown. 2. No server-enforced confirmation parameter, preview-confirm flow, or Elicitation mechanism was found. 3. Zoho says agent actions follow user-level permissions; Mail admin actions require Zoho Mail administrative privileges. Mail OAuth docs describe user-level on-demand authorization or a Super Admin-authorized organization connection that may be shared with trusted members. OAuth scopes are reviewed during authorization, but exact scope names for this endpoint are unavailable. 4. The creator selects tools and products. Multiple services may be combined into one endpoint; docs recommend separate servers for access isolation and sensitive data, and state users cannot be restricted to one service within a combined server. Zoho Mail's configuration docs identify regional data centers. No documented read-only flag, URL tool filter, or sandbox mode found for this endpoint. 5. No MCP-level PII masking or field exclusion found. Mail docs say responses are not stored and say data sent to AI agents is not encrypted; security standards apply when Mail tools access Mail APIs. 6. Calls consume the existing APIs' quotas; no MCP-specific rate limits or truncation found. Zoho recommends creating a new server when the tool list exceeds 300. 7. Tool schemas and server validation/correction behavior are not published for this endpoint. 8. Zoho marketing claims audit trails; specific MCP invocation logging, retention, and opt-out behavior were not documented. Mail includes product audit-record tools. 9. No feedback/rating/report/survey tools or upsell result instructions appear in the 91 names of the official Mail reference; the other configurable service tools were not fully enumerated. 10. No server-delivered skill tools were found in the reviewed docs. Mail docs advise selecting only required tools, but this is a recommendation to the operator/client. 11. No evidence that prior agent behavior changes future tool results or availability. 12. Non-flat configuration: customers may combine tools from multiple Zoho products and third-party services into one endpoint; separate regional origins and separate CRM pre-built servers also exist. 13. No raw API, arbitrary SQL, script execution, or universal escape-hatch tool was found in the visible official Mail list; the full configured toolset is unknown.
behavioural_instructions_to_ai_verbatim: Ensure you select only the tools required for your planned actions. Selecting only the necessary tools helps AI assistants to provide faster and accurate results.
Zoho recommends creating a new server when the number of tools in a server exceeds 300.
D_server_side_logic.server_structure_explanation: Tool availability is configured dynamically by each customer; one server can combine selected tools from multiple Zoho products and third-party services. Zoho also publishes regional origins and separate pre-built CRM servers.

E_aggregated.token_method: No public code for the customer-configured server and no endpoint-specific verbatim tool definitions or initialize instructions were available.
E_aggregated.human_can_agent_cannot: A human can use the connected Zoho applications' interfaces and APIs to perform operations beyond the tools selected for a given MCP server. The precise excluded operations cannot be determined for this endpoint because its configured products and tools are unknown. Zoho CRM docs describe four separate server groups; capabilities outside an installed group are not exposed by that CRM server.

F_documentation.implementation_hints_not_enforced: Zoho Mail docs recommend selecting only needed tools and grouping services by workflow. They say to re-authenticate after adding tools because clients may not detect changes automatically, and recommend a new server above 300 tools. These are operator/client recommendations; no server enforcement mechanism is documented.
F_documentation.governance_promises: Zoho says agents operate under user-level permissions and that Mail responses are not stored. Mail docs also warn: "Data sent to the AI agents is not encrypted." Zoho's general MCP page claims "All data access and agent actions are governed by strict access controls, encrypted data handling, and audit trails"; the Mail-specific statement about agent-bound data not being encrypted qualifies that broader claim.
F_documentation.promises_to_user: Zoho describes MCP as free, model-agnostic, and using existing service APIs and quotas. It says a unique secure URL is generated for each configured server and removing the server details from the AI client's connectors removes that client's mailbox access.
F_documentation.comparison_with_server_logic: Tool selection, unique URLs, and OAuth are documented product behavior. Role inheritance is documented at a high level. Claims about audit trails and encrypted handling are not supported with endpoint-specific implementation evidence; Mail documentation explicitly says data sent to agents is not encrypted. Server-side retention, masking, invocation logs, and confirmation enforcement remain undocumented.

contradictions: Zoho's general MCP page claims encrypted data handling, while Zoho Mail's FAQ says: "Data sent to the AI agents is not encrypted." These statements refer to different portions of the flow or conflict in scope; the docs do not reconcile them.

The third-party Zoho MCP Tool Manual reports 184 Zoho Mail tools and 15,718 tools across 74 services. The official Zoho Mail tool-reference tables expose 91 unique tool names in the collected page; the third-party reference's full listing could not be retrieved, so the difference cannot be resolved.
observations_for_research: The customer/server operator controls the agent's available action surface by selecting tools at endpoint creation and later configuration.
Zoho documents both user-specific OAuth and an organization-level shared connection authorized by a Super Admin, creating distinct identity and permission arrangements.
Zoho's documentation favors combining services for workflow continuity while also recommending separate servers for sensitive-data and access isolation cases.
